method: First five ordinary web results returned per query, excluding separately returned news/social blocks. This is a search-tool sample, not a controlled Google top-five ranking capture. Results can mix language, location, cache age and intent. Some entries were reviewed as result snippets only; coverage is recorded per entry. No rank positions are claimed.

samples.query: wanneer ballon d or 2026 tijd datum stemmen

results.observation: Official organizer guide gives date, venue, 20:00 GMT / 21:00 CET, nominees and viewing link. Stronger immediate time/viewing answer than current site article.
Separate Ballon d’Or Of All Time public vote and draw. Not annual journalist award rules; demonstrates mixed intent and why a ballot distinction matters.
Dutch question title focuses on where/when to watch and answers 21:00 Netherlands time.
Broadcaster viewing intent, event-time-channel table; result title and body displayed different years, so do not trust the snippet for factual publication.
Official nominee announcement addresses shortlist rather than start time.

samples.action: Keep already-correct short voting explanation; add verified start time and official watching link. Use event-date guard; update only after official result.

results.observation: Existing dynamic direct-free-kick total page; this should own current numerical answer.
Multi-metric table includes direct free kicks with broad career comparison. Different totals mean scopes/cutoffs must be inspected; not evidence to silently replace site data.
Records index claims match-by-match counts and a free-kick leaderboard. Underlying records were not independently audited.

samples.action: Keep historical explainer and current record distinct. Implemented specific record link above body and exact CTA; title shortening is a CMS draft, not a silent historical-stat update.

results.observation: Primary provider competition/year table displays selected coverage; strong traceability. Visible row sample is not a complete independent audit of every career match.
Shows 37 international assists plus year-by-year rows and definition discussion. Explicitly says it does not use Opta as a direct source, despite its Opta label.
Provider overview snippet states a different assist total (20). Difference is confirmed at presentation level; cause and total sample were not reconciled.
Goals-focused official page asks who assisted Ronaldo, which is different from assists Ronaldo provided.
Year-only national-team assists, not all-career national-team assists; further scope ambiguity.

samples.action: Maintain named-source dynamic answer already present; prioritize event/competition reconciliation and a provider-coverage table. Do not claim all discrepancy is a definition issue without checking.

results.observation: Direct year goals answer, goals/assists/appearances table and explicit calendar-year versus season note.

results.review: full live page plus search snippet
results.observation: Own live page had generic intro without numeric answer; search snippet used an older snapshot. Search cache age is not proof live data is stale.
Own current career totals answer competes for year-qualified phrasing; separate annual intent needs clearer navigation.
Career milestone tracker emphasizing distance to 1,000 and dated individual milestones; not a January-to-December comparison.
Total, per-game and age comparisons with season notes; broader comparative intent.

samples.action: Implemented dynamic yearly total in /2026 intro and reciprocal /goals↔/2026 answers. Query-page export needed to establish cannibalization rather than guessing from similar titles.

confirmed: Structured career comparisons and broad topical navigation exist.
Free-kick and assist pages provide year breakdowns.
Match-history, opponent, age and other filter destinations are exposed in navigation.
The Rivalry methodology identifies this competitor as the secondary baseline source.
named_competitor_review.likely_implication: A site reusing its main baseline needs distinct reader value and independently traceable additions to be a better citation target. Existing equal-appearance calculations and explicit coverage gaps are useful differentiators.
not_measured: Full accuracy of the competitor ledger

already_fixed_live_do_not_repeat: Peak-year article includes the numeric comparison table, 50-appearance worked calculation and downloadable CSV.
Penalty article includes matched-date scored, attempts, misses and conversion table at the top.
About page identifies Arshad Nawaz Baig as editor and contains an existing biography, profile link and AI-assistance/editorial-policy disclosure.
Main comparisons and article text are visible in fetched HTML; generic JavaScript-only content is not a supported diagnosis.
